department: School of Communication Sciences and Disorders

deadline.value: Submit at least four weeks before February 1, 2027 for Fall admission and funding consideration.
deadline.quote: DO Submit your application at least 4 weeks prior to the February 1, 2027, deadline

gre_subject.value: The school page names no subject test for neuroscience.

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to find a compatible faculty member and contact them before applying.
supervisor.quote: Once you have found someone who looks compatible, call that person and discuss your interest in the Ph.D. program

funding.value: Full assistantships (tuition and stipend) go to the most meritorious applicants.
funding.quote: Full graduate assistantship funding (tuition +stipend) is available for the most meritorious applicants

entry_route.value: Applicants must have a bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited institution.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must submit proof that they have earned a bachelor's or master's degree

app_fee.value: Applications go through CSDCAS, which sets its own fee; the fetched page gives no amount.
app_fee.quote: Applications for the PhD program in Communication Sciences & Disorders must be submitted

fee_waiver.value: Students who qualify can request an application fee waiver from CSDCAS.
fee_waiver.quote: Students who qualify can request an Application Fee Waiver from CSDCAS

gre_general.value: Applicants must take the GRE General Test; scores must be no more than five years old.
gre_general.quote: Applicants are required to take the Graduate Record Examination (GRE-General Test)

toefl_min.value: Non-native English speakers must have at least 80 on the internet-based TOEFL.
toefl_min.quote: must supply a minimum score of 80 on the internet-based Test of English

ielts_min.value: The minimum accepted IELTS score is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable IELTS score is 6.5

english_waiver.value: The English requirement can be waived for students with a degree from an English-language university.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement can be waived for students who have received a degree from an English-language University

notes: Neuroscience is one of three concentrations of the School's PhD in Communication Sciences and Disorders. Applications go through CSDCAS, not the Graduate School portal, so the school values override the university record. The official PhD deadline is stated for Fall 2027.
name: Communication Sciences and Disorders (PhD), Neuroscience concentration
